findings.title: SDA and SCL are swapped
findings.explanation: The sensor's SDA (yellow wire) lands on GPIO22 and its SCL (green wire) on GPIO21. The ESP32's default I2C pins are SDA=GPIO21, SCL=GPIO22, which is why the bus scan finds no device.
findings.fix: Swap the yellow and green wires at I15 and I18.
